title: Job's Health Afflicted

questions.question: What did Satan challenge God with the second time?
options: Skin for skin! All that a man has he will give for his life
questions.correctAnswer: Skin for skin! All that a man has he will give for his life
questions.explanation: Job 2:4 (ESV): "Then Satan answered the LORD and said, 'Skin for skin! All that a man has he will give for his life.'"

questions.question: What affliction did Satan bring upon Job?
options: Loathsome sores from the sole of his foot to the crown of his head
questions.correctAnswer: Loathsome sores from the sole of his foot to the crown of his head
questions.explanation: Job 2:7 (ESV): "...and struck Job with loathsome sores from the sole of his foot to the crown of his head."

questions.question: What did Job utilize to scrape his sores?
questions.explanation: Job 2:8 (ESV): "And he took a piece of broken pottery with which to scrape himself while he sat in the ashes."

questions.question: What did Job's wife say to him?
options: Do you still hold fast your integrity? Curse God and die.
questions.correctAnswer: Do you still hold fast your integrity? Curse God and die.
questions.explanation: Job 2:9 (ESV): "Then his wife said to him, 'Do you still hold fast your integrity? Curse God and die.'"

questions.question: Who came to comfort Job?
questions.explanation: Job 2:11 (ESV): "...Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite."

questions.question: How did Job respond to his wife?
options: You speak as one of the foolish women would speak
questions.correctAnswer: You speak as one of the foolish women would speak
questions.explanation: Job 2:10 (ESV): "But he said to her, 'You speak as one of the foolish women would speak.'"

questions.question: What rhetorical question did Job ask his wife?
options: Shall we receive good from God, and shall we not receive evil?
questions.correctAnswer: Shall we receive good from God, and shall we not receive evil?
questions.explanation: Job 2:10 (ESV): "...Shall we receive good from God, and shall we not receive evil?"

questions.question: Did Job sin with his lips in this?
questions.explanation: Job 2:10 (ESV): "...In all this Job did not sin with his lips."

questions.question: What did Job's friends do when they saw him from a distance?
questions.explanation: Job 2:12 (ESV): "And when they saw him from a distance, they did not recognize him."

questions.question: How long did the friends sit with Job in silence?
questions.explanation: Job 2:13 (ESV): "And they sat with him on the ground seven days and seven nights..."

questions.question: Why did the friends sit in silence?
options: For they saw that his suffering was very great
questions.correctAnswer: For they saw that his suffering was very great
questions.explanation: Job 2:13 (ESV): "...and no one spoke a word to him, for they saw that his suffering was very great."

questions.question: What specific restriction did God place on Satan this second time?
questions.explanation: Job 2:6 (ESV): "...Behold, he is in your hand; only spare his life."

questions.question: From where did Satan come to present himself before the Lord?
options: From going to and fro on the earth
questions.correctAnswer: From going to and fro on the earth
questions.explanation: Job 2:2 (ESV): "...From going to and fro on the earth, and from walking up and down on it."

questions.question: What did God say Job still held fast to?
questions.explanation: Job 2:3 (ESV): "...He still holds fast his integrity, although you incited me against him to destroy him without reason."

questions.question: Where was Job sitting when he scraped himself?
questions.explanation: Job 2:8 (ESV): "...while he sat in the ashes."

key_verse_text: But he said to her, “You speak as one of the foolish women would speak. Shall we receive good from God, and shall we not receive evil?” In all this Job did not sin with his lips.
